scenes.headline: How Mamba keeps a fixed-size memory
scenes.sub: Selective state spaces, the parallel scan, and Mamba-2's chunked matmuls
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pimpernel! Attention keeps every token. Mamba keeps one small state, and chooses what goes in.

scenes.text: Make the step size and the read and write projections functions of each token, so a fixed-size state chooses what to keep and what to forget.
scenes.say: The idea: each token sets its own step size and projections, so the state chooses what to keep.

scenes.title: One step, one channel
scenes.text: h_t = exp(ΔA) h_t-1 + ΔB x_t,  y_t = C h_t

parts.note: decay: a small step keeps the state
parts.say: The exponential decays the state. A small step keeps it; a large one wipes it.

parts.note: write: the token enters, scaled by its step
parts.say: Delta times B writes the token in.

parts.note: read: C chooses what leaves the state
parts.say: C reads it out. All three come from the token itself.

left.title: S4: time-invariant
items: Same A, B and C at every step
left.say: S4 fixed them per layer, so it unrolled into one long convolution, blind to content.

right.title: Mamba: selective
items: Δ, B and C computed per token
No kernel, so a parallel scan
right.say: Selection breaks the convolution. Mamba runs a scan instead, and can skip filler.

scenes.title: The scan never leaves the chip

steps.say: Only the small inputs sit in slow memory.

steps.note: the expanded state is N times the input
steps.say: They're loaded once into fast on-chip memory, where each step's decay is computed.

steps.note: 20-40x faster than a standard PyTorch scan
steps.say: The scan runs there, never writing the big state out.
Only the outputs go back. Backward recomputes the states.

scenes.title: Mamba-2: the same layer as masked attention

steps.label: Scalar decay: one masked matrix
steps.note: computed in chunks of 256: matmuls inside, a short recurrence between
steps.say: Mamba-2 makes the decay one number per head. Then the layer is one masked matrix, attention without softmax, computed in chunks of matrix multiplies.

scenes.title: Memory per sequence at 2,048 tokens
scenes.note: the states are fixed; Pythia's cache grows 320 KiB per token
scenes.say: At two thousand tokens, a Transformer's cache is over six hundred megabytes. Mamba's state is about twelve, and fixed.

steps.say: But a fixed state can't copy a long document back. So hybrids keep some attention: one layer in four, here.
Only those layers keep a cache that grows.

scenes.text: Selection lets a fixed-size state decide what to remember; a few attention layers handle what must be recalled exactly.
scenes.say: A selective state decides what to remember. A few attention layers recall the rest exactly.

recap: Selection: Δ, B and C from each token
A fused scan, then Mamba-2's chunked matmuls
A fixed state; hybrids keep some attention
scenes.say: Selection from each token. A scan, then chunked matrix multiplies. A fixed state, with a little attention.
